title: Steelers GM Omar Khan on Aaron Rodgers: Great communication, he knows how we feel about him

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers GM Omar Khan on Aaron Rodgers: Great communication, he knows how we feel about him
sources.description: Monday morning brought a report that the Steelers have not received word from quarterback Aaron Rodgers about his 2026 plans and that they do not expect to get that word before the draft starts on Thursday night.
